## Documented role

[Van der Klift and Norman Kunc, “Hell-Bent on Helping” (1994)](../sources/1994-van-der-klift-hell-bent.qmd) is a published chapter on help and inclusive education. The Broadreach republication we have read does **not** name ECPM, CSIL, BC Rehab, Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, or Vancouver Health Department.

No public source in this catalogue that we have read identifies her as author of a 1994 ECPM training manual. The 1990 ECPM manual’s Roeher entry names corporate authors only.

This archive does **not** infer ECPM or CSIL design-group membership.

## Later accounts

None recorded from a public source we have read. Early project notes *name* her in connection with a possible 1994 ECPM training revision. That is a hypothesis about a missing document, not a cited recollection. See the [wanted ECPM manuals record](../sources/wanted-ecpm-manuals.qmd) and the [ECPM chapter](../history/ecpm.qmd).

## Unresolved

- Whether a 1994 ECPM training manual exists and, if so, whether she is named on it.
- Whether “1994 ECPM manual” in later notes is a conflicting citation of the 1990 Roeher-listed manual, a distinct edition, or a confusion with this 1994 chapter.
- The evidence is not clear enough to decide that identity question.

This page does not invite unsolicited contact.
